record_title: Sharp p-adic hierarchy for shifted generalized Domb sums
scientific_context: For T_{A,B,C}(n)=sum_k binom(n+k-1,k)^A binom(2k,k)^B binom(2(n-k),n-k)^C with A>=0 and B,C>=1, proves T(mp^r) congruent to T(mp^(r-1)) modulo p^(min(A+1,3)r) for primes p>=5. The cubic A>=2 layer proves the full generalized supercongruence conjectured on OEIS A364111; the three uniform exponents are shown sharp.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The result is restricted to primes p>=5 and B,C>=1. It does not prove the stronger cubic conjecture for the special A=1,B=C=1 sequence OEIS A362676. Matthijs Coster's 1988 thesis Supercongruences was not inspected in full and remains the principal source-access priority risk. Exact computations are corroborative only. No independent validation, independent audit, or formal proof-assistant verification is asserted.

artifact_inventory.description: Standalone exact-integer verification of the A364111 prefix, representative instances of the p-adic hierarchy, and the sharpness examples.
